# Entertainment Partners

> > Entertainment Partners provides industry-leading production management software, payroll services, tax incentive consulting, and health insurance solutions for film and television production worldwide.

EP serves the entertainment industry with integrated tools including Movie Magic Budgeting and Scheduling software, production payroll services across the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand, and ACA-compliant health insurance through EP Cares. The company also offers EP Academy training courses and expert guidance on production incentives and tax credits.

## Key Topics

- Movie Magic Budgeting & Scheduling
- Production payroll services
- Film tax credits and incentives
- EP Cares health insurance
- ACA compliance
- Production financing strategies
- International production services (UK, Canada, Australia, New Zealand)
- Production accounting
- myEP platform
- Film and television production management
- State and regional tax incentives
- Independent film financing
- Crew and talent benefits
- Production software training
- Entertainment industry compliance

## Film Financing & Production Incentives

- [The State of Film & Television Production: 2024 in Review and Outlook for 2025 - Entertainment Partners](https://www.ep.com/blog/film-incentives-north-america-entertainment-industry-2024-review-look-ahead-2025): Joseph Chianese reviews 2024 production trends & 2025 industry outlook
- [The Independent Filmmaker's Guide to Production Incentives - Entertainment Partners](https://www.ep.com/blog/independent-filmmakers-guide-to-production-incentives): Joseph Chianese's guide to tax credits & rebates for indie filmmakers
- [The Beginner's Guide to Production Financing - Entertainment Partners](https://www.ep.com/blog/the-beginners-guide-to-production-financing): John Hadity's guide to film/TV financing, tax credits & equity investment
- [The Beginner's Guide to the Film Financing Waterfall - Entertainment Partners](https://www.ep.com/blog/the-beginners-guide-to-the-film-financing-waterfall): John Hadity explains financing waterfall & recoupment schedules
- [The Beginner's Guide to Pre-Selling a Film - Entertainment Partners](https://www.ep.com/blog/the-beginners-guide-to-pre-selling-a-film): John Hadity on working with sales agents for film pre-sales & financing
- [Illinois' Film Scene Grows to New Heights with Expanded Tax Incentives - Entertainment Partners](https://www.ep.com/blog/illinois-historic-film-scene-grows-to-new-heights-with-expanded-tax-incentives): Illinois film tax incentive expansion & Chicago production growth analysis
